## G. Split-based evaluations (EMBEDDED)

**E1 PG/TPC-H** (Step 5 (theta=1.2 event, candidate-level)): realized rate 0.021 vs alpha 0.1, violations 1/20, speedup 9.6%, capture 26.8%.

**E1 PG/JOB** (Step 7f (materially-severe, candidate-level)): severe rate 0.087, violations 7/20 (ANTI-CONSERVATIVE - motivates Sec 4.3), speedup 22.8%. These numbers demonstrate the anti-conservativeness of candidate-level calibration and are NOT quotable as certified results.

**E2 shift boundaries:**

- PG/TPC-H template shift: rate 0.30 vs alpha 0.10 (33 steers, 10 reg) (Step 5)
- PG/JOB family shift: rate 0.32 vs alpha 0.10 (25 steers, 8 severe) (Step 7f)

**E3 transfer:** TPC-H-trained gate on all 113 JOB queries: 11 steers, 0 regressions, +0.1% speedup - safety transfers, utility does not (Step 7c).
